statistical_disentanglement.definition: Non-parametric optimization to minimize MI between feature elements via learned weights
statistical_disentanglement.our_implementation: Learnable sigmoid-constrained weights with sorting for order preservation
statistical_disentanglement.fidelity: APPROXIMATE - uses gradient-based optimization instead of SMT solver

representational_disentanglement.definition: Orthogonality regularization on temporal node representations

memory_module.definition: GRU-based node memory with message passing
memory_module.3D-IDS_original: RNN for messages, GRU for memory update

graph_diffusion.definition: Perona-Malik nonlinear diffusion with layer-temporal coefficients
graph_diffusion.3D-IDS_original: Continuous ODE solved via Runge-Kutta with multi-layer graph
graph_diffusion.fidelity: APPROXIMATE - simplified solver and single-layer data

multi_scale_fusion.definition: Multi-scale representation fusion for few-shot learning
multi_scale_fusion.our_implementation: Three-scale encoder with concatenation and fusion MLP

two_step_classification.definition: Binary classification followed by multi-class classification

deviations: SMT solver replaced with gradient-based optimization for statistical disentanglement
Runge-Kutta replaced with Euler integration for graph diffusion ODE
Reduced model dimensions (32 vs typical 128-256) due to CPU-only training
Single-layer graph only (dataset limitation, not model limitation)
